latest_release.body:
## English

### Summary

This patch fixes Function Models selectors collapsing into vertically wrapped text. It also includes the shared HTML/SVG preview fixes and Prompt Garden evaluation-prompt integration already merged after v2.15.0.

### Highlights

- Restore readable Function Models selectors on desktop and narrow screens.
- Expand a single HTML/SVG preview in fullscreen and surface preview execution errors.
- Open common model-evaluation prompts from Prompt Garden directly in Arena.

### Product Updates

#### Desktop

- Apply the shared selector layout and HTML/SVG preview improvements.

#### Web

- Add the evaluation-prompt entry in Arena and support imports from Prompt Garden, including selected example variables and reference images.
- Preserve test columns and previous results when importing; imports do not automatically start model requests.

#### Extension

- Apply the shared selector and preview improvements, including error reporting from the packaged preview sandbox.

#### Core/Infra

- Reuse existing session and preview components for Garden imports and result rendering.

### Fixes

- Give Function Models selectors a stable layout wrapper so scoped width rules reach the intended element; keep placeholder text on one line.
- Recognize standalone SVG and SVG code fences, and fit fixed-size SVG graphics to the preview viewport.
- Let a single HTML/SVG artifact use the available fullscreen area.
- Display errors reported by preview scripts, modules, resources and unhandled promises, with frame and preview-revision checks.

### Breaking Changes / Upgrade Notes

- No breaking changes or backup-format migration.
- Extension ZIP version is `2.15.1`; installation remains manual, without an extension-store submission.
- Desktop uses the stable update channel. Docker publishes `2.15.1` and promotes the verified image to `latest` in both registries.

### Developer Notes

- Selector validation includes 16 existing component tests, the UI bundle build, lint, and rendered checks at desktop and 390px widths.
- Shared preview and Garden import changes passed the existing master CI before this patch release was prepared.
- The release workflow runs the existing repository and browser gates, then builds desktop, extension and both multi-architecture images from the same tagged commit before publication.

Installation guide: [English](https://github.com/linshenkx/prompt-optimizer/blob/v2.15.1/mkdocs/docs/en/deployment/desktop.md) | [中文](https://github.com/linshenkx/prompt-optimizer/blob/v2.15.1/mkdocs/docs/zh/deployment/desktop.md)
[Source release notes (EN)](https://github.com/linshenkx/prompt-optimizer/blob/v2.15.1/releases/v2.15.1.en.md)

---

## 中文

### 概括

本补丁修复功能模型选择框被挤成竖排的问题，同时收录 v2.15.0 之后已合入的共用 HTML/SVG 预览修复与 Prompt Garden 竞技场测评题集成。

### 亮点

- 恢复桌面与窄屏下功能模型选择框的正常宽度。
- 单个 HTML/SVG 预览充分使用全屏空间，并显示预览执行错误。
- 从 Prompt Garden 快速选用常见模型测评提示词，在竞技场中比较模型表现。

### 产品更新

#### Desktop

- 应用共用模型选择框布局与 HTML/SVG 预览改进。

#### Web

- 在竞技场增加测评题入口，支持从 Prompt Garden 导入所选示例的变量及参考图片。
- 导入时保留测试栏和已有结果，不自动发起模型请求。

#### Extension

- 应用共用选择框与预览改进，支持显示打包预览页面报告的错误。

#### Core/Infra

- Garden 导入与结果显示沿用已有会话和预览组件。

### 修复

- 为功能模型选择框提供稳定的布局容器，确保宽度样式生效，并让占位文本保持单行。
- 识别独立 SVG 文档及 SVG 代码块，让固定尺寸图形适应预览区域。
- 让单个 HTML/SVG 内容在全屏时使用可用空间。
- 显示预览脚本、模块、资源及未处理 Promise 报告的错误，并校验消息来源和预览版本。

### 破坏性变更 / 升级说明

- 无破坏性变更，无需迁移备份格式。
- 扩展 ZIP 版本为 `2.15.1`，继续供手动安装，本次不提交扩展商店。
- 桌面发布进入稳定更新渠道；Docker 发布 `2.15.1`，验证后将同一镜像提升为两个仓库的 `latest`。

### 开发者说明

- 选择框修复已通过 16 项已有组件测试、UI 构建、代码检查，以及桌面和 390px 窄屏的实际页面检查。
- 共用预览与 Garden 导入变更在准备本补丁版本前已通过 master 上的现有 CI。
- 发布流程执行现有仓库与浏览器门禁，从同一标签提交构建桌面、扩展及双仓库多架构镜像，全部成功后再公开版本。

安装文档：[English](https://github.com/linshenkx/prompt-optimizer/blob/v2.15.1/mkdocs/docs/en/deployment/desktop.md) | [中文](https://github.com/linshenkx/prompt-optimizer/blob/v2.15.1/mkdocs/docs/zh/deployment/desktop.md)
[仓库版本说明（中文）](https://github.com/linshenkx/prompt-optimizer/blob/v2.15.1/releases/v2.15.1.zh-CN.md)

## 📖 Project Introduction Prompt Optimizer is a powerful AI prompt optimization tool that helps you write better AI prompts and improve the quality of AI outputs. It supports four usage methods: web application, desktop application, Chrome extension, and Docker deployment. Prompts can start from manual writing, templates, local imports, or sources such as [Prompt Garden](https://garden.always200.com). Prompt Optimizer is where those prompts are optimized, tested, evaluated, and saved as reusable prompt assets. ### 🎥 Feature Demonstration

1. Hard-Nosed Reviewer: Turn Agreement into Useful Critique

Starting from a minimal English role prompt, optimization pushes a small model away from generic pushback and toward a clearer, more structured review that surfaces weak assumptions, evidence gaps, and concrete revision advice.
